symptom: new commands collide with a queued/unposted result
root_cause: control plane advanced before prior result delivery became certain
preferred_pattern: when a prior result is pending/posting, do not advance delivery; terminal job events wait behind the parent result

symptom: source on disk differs from observed runtime behavior
root_cause: mutated component was not activated
preferred_pattern: reload/restart mutated component and reload/re-arm target before acceptance

symptom: patches created against partial/stale source
root_cause: canonical full source was absent
preferred_pattern: obtain exact canonical full source/commit before nontrivial implementation

symptom: same-class failures cause patch-on-patch debugging on user PC
root_cause: development continued inside acceptance environment
preferred_pattern: after two same-class failures stop mutation, collect evidence, reproduce off-PC, rebuild

symptom: launcher fails setting active_version
root_cause: PSCustomObject missing later-mutated lifecycle properties
preferred_pattern: predeclare mutable lifecycle properties or Add-Member -Force; regression-test them

symptom: Agent-mediated preflight self-call times out
root_cause: single request loop synchronously called same Agent API
preferred_pattern: same-Agent health checks are external/post-restart; never synchronous self-call

symptom: Windows-only semantics first fail on user PC
root_cause: release candidate skipped clean Windows gate
preferred_pattern: run Windows-specific release candidates on GitHub-hosted Windows before real-PC acceptance

symptom: gh run download times out while run/log remains readable
root_cause: Actions artifacts use a separate blob backend
preferred_pattern: status/job/log are Result Plane; binary Actions artifact is optional Artifact Plane

symptom: long CI wait would block synchronous Agent request
root_cause: process.run in request path is synchronous
preferred_pattern: submit wait/collect as detached job worker; Extension posts terminal summary later

symptom: large carriers truncate/fail
root_cause: bulk data used control plane
preferred_pattern: keep carrier small and move scripts/archives/evidence to Artifact Plane

symptom: archive working tree looks dirty from EOL/omissions
root_cause: transport changed representation while git objects identify exact commit
preferred_pattern: reconstruct exact canonical bytes from verified commit before development

symptom: new chat assumes direct GitHub/Windows access or asks user to restate Bridge architecture
root_cause: access-plane constraint was treated as conversational context instead of durable contract
preferred_pattern: treat SOKNA Bridge as Chat agent access plane to authenticated GitHub/user PC; select route from canonical policy before commands

symptom: small fix expands into many read/patch/push round trips
root_cause: work was split across control-plane interactions and GitHub used as scratchpad
preferred_pattern: workspace-first batch: acquire full source once, implement/test locally, push only a validated milestone, then CI and real-PC acceptance

symptom: malformed manually encoded carrier causes silent or delayed progress
root_cause: carrier/Base64 was hand assembled instead of generated and round-trip validated
preferred_pattern: always use deterministic carrier generator; V3 for Extension <3.10 and V4 for >=3.10; never hand-edit encoded output

symptom: a secondary PC is mistaken for accepted baseline
root_cause: live machine version was assumed from repo/handoff
preferred_pattern: probe live Agent/Extension first; older PCs are access/acceptance endpoints until explicitly upgraded and accepted

lesson: In Windows PowerShell 5.1, a native command that emits zero stdout lines assigns $null, so calling .Trim() directly on (& git/gh ...) can crash before fail-closed logic. Capture native output as @(...), check $LASTEXITCODE, join lines, then Trim(). Apply this to probes such as git ls-remote and git branch --list.

A user/acceptance PC must not be treated as a development environment. Publish harnesses must not assume Node/Python/npm or rerun developer suites there. Perform full deterministic validation in the development workspace, then on the acceptance endpoint require only the minimal publish plane (PowerShell + git + gh), verify artifact/base/hashes/staged allowlist/diff, push once, and delegate clean-environment validation to CI.

GitHub Windows CI run 35881300733 showed the PowerShell pipeline form <json> | python tools/sokna_carrier_guard.py reaching Python with empty stdin. For deterministic Windows CI carrier tests, pass the serialized command explicitly with --json, check $LASTEXITCODE, then assert the expected V3/V4 marker. Do not rely on PowerShell-to-native stdin for this gate.

symptom: a failure discovered on the user PC triggers direct source edits or toolchain-driven debugging on that same PC
root_cause: the acceptance endpoint was allowed to become a development workspace
preferred_pattern: treat endpoint failures as evidence only: capture exact failure, reproduce and fix in the development workspace, rebuild a complete candidate/artifact, then return only for integrity checks, CI handoff, activation or final acceptance
evidence: 2026-09-24 UTF-8 and PowerShell findings discovered on home PC

symptom: Python source-contract test passes on Linux but fails on Windows with mojibake when reading Persian/UTF-8 repository text
root_cause: Path.read_text() used the platform default encoding instead of an explicit UTF-8 encoding
preferred_pattern: repository text/JSON/markdown reads in cross-platform Python tests use read_text(encoding='utf-8'); Windows CI remains the validation gate
evidence: 2026-09-24 home pre-CI P4 contract failure on Python 3.14 Windows

symptom: Windows PowerShell 5.1 parser rejected a compact chained cast/method expression in Sokna.Component.psm1
root_cause: PowerShell-5.1 compatibility was not parser-validated before the RC was presented to the endpoint
preferred_pattern: write conservative PS5.1-compatible expressions with intermediate variables; parser-check every .ps1/.psm1 in clean Windows CI before endpoint acceptance

symptom: a deterministic multi-step check is split into repeated chat commands, increasing latency and user-visible round trips
root_cause: Result-First was misread as one-step-per-message instead of one-outer-command-at-a-time
preferred_pattern: before every Bridge command choose the fastest safe route: for 2+ bounded deterministic steps use one job.batch (up to runtime limit); for multi-step mutations use plan.run/job.submit; Result-First applies between outer commands, not steps inside batch/plan
evidence: 2026-09-24 user correction on excessive round trips

symptom: new agents repeatedly promise to use Bridge efficiently but require the user to remind them about batching, artifacts or carrier preflight
root_cause: Bridge operating rules were documentation facts but not promoted to a mandatory per-session execution gate in READ-FIRST
preferred_pattern: read BRIDGE_SESSION_EXECUTION_GATE_V1_FA before any Bridge session and treat route selection + carrier guard as hard gates; never wait for user reminder

symptom: a batch begins with artifact.inspect/apply while a prerequisite dirty overlay still exists, causing deterministic apply-check failure before the cleanup step can run
root_cause: dependency order inside the batch was wrong; cleanup/reconcile was placed after the first consumer step
preferred_pattern: within one outer job.batch, order dependency chains strictly: reconcile/cleanup first, then inspect, then apply, then verify/publish probes; stop_on_error=true on the chain. Batch-first never means ignoring prerequisite ordering
evidence: 2026-09-24 rc3-pubprep-20 failed at first artifact.inspect before its planned stash step

symptom: byte-identical source candidate produces a different Git tree hash after canonicalization on Windows
root_cause: Git tree hashes include file modes; Linux freeze carried executable bits on two Python files while Windows canonical staging normalized them to 100644
preferred_pattern: when bytes match but tree hash differs across Linux/Windows, compare git ls-tree modes before rejecting the candidate; normalize non-launcher Python/test files to 100644 in the development freeze policy, then compare tree hashes again
evidence: 2026-09-24 RC3 expected tree 3eccbfe845992e4fdc5c442b065c88f49838536a vs canonical Windows tree 190380434740f0fa1b5df5c3dd9f4d8cbd9f4178
mode-only simulation reproduced canonical tree exactly by removing +x from tools/release/Build-R1SourceRC.py and tools/tests/test_p3_browser_visual_qa.py

symptom: Native Artifact Provider rejects ordinary GitHub Actions Windows temp paths such as C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\... as reparse/symlink paths
root_cause: path security compared filepath.EvalSymlinks output text to the original absolute path; Windows 8.3 short-name aliases can expand to a long canonical name without any reparse point, producing a false positive
preferred_pattern: detect links/reparse boundaries from filesystem metadata on every existing path ancestor (Lstat; reject symlink/irregular reparse) rather than textual path canonicalization; preserve traversal and real symlink/junction fail-closed behavior
evidence: 2026-09-24 exact-RC Windows CI run 35946302187 failed eight provider tests on RUNNER~1 temp paths
development provider suite passes after ancestor-Lstat fix; Windows cross-compile succeeds
2026-09-24 RC4 exact-RC Windows CI run 35947423759 Native artifact provider tests PASS at step 19

symptom: Windows PowerShell 5.1 strict mode throws PropertyNotFoundStrict when test code reads .Count from an empty/optional collection property
root_cause: PowerShell pipeline/property semantics can yield $null or a scalar instead of an array even when the logical contract is collection-shaped
preferred_pattern: when cardinality is the intent, always normalize with @(...).Count at the assertion boundary; sweep sibling Windows acceptance scripts for the same pattern before cutting the next RC
evidence: 2026-09-24 RC4 exact-RC Windows CI run 35947423759 failed Test-Workspace260.ps1 at $lw.tools.Count
RC4 Provider fix passed in the same run, proving this was the next independent Windows compatibility failure

symptom: user must relay several gh run status results while a durable job worker already exists
root_cause: chat manually polled GitHub Actions instead of using the existing job.submit CI plan
preferred_pattern: for full GitHub Windows validation, submit tools/plans/github-windows-ci-full.json through job.submit; the detached worker dispatches, waits, collects failure logs and emits one terminal result. Manual gh run view polling is fallback-only

symptom: each exact-RC Windows run stops at the first independent failure, causing one small RC per newly revealed problem
root_cause: CI diagnostic steps were fail-fast and skipped the remaining Windows matrices, so the failure set was discovered serially
preferred_pattern: run independent source/native/Windows acceptance diagnostics with continue-on-error, aggregate all outcomes in one Windows diagnostic gate, and block installer/build promotion until that gate is fully green. After any Windows failure, sweep the entire failure family before the next RC
evidence: RC3 run 35946302187 stopped at Native Provider and skipped later matrices
RC4 run 35947423759 Provider passed then stopped at Workspace step 22, leaving later matrices unobserved
